messages:
maria: Heads up — final publish window for Py/TS SDKs is 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC. Need pin matrix, signer regen checklist, and docs sync. I'll kick off the canary at 16:00. @raj can you set rollback window to 30m?

deploy-bot: Canary publish initiated for packages: `redwood-sdk-py@canary` (build 20250610-pt1), `redwood-sdk-ts@canary` (build 20250610-tt1). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/20250610-pt1

raj: rolling window set to 30m, will monitor. I also set a canary guardrail: >95% smoke pass across latency and auth checks.

kai: FYI CDN invalidation will take ~60s after final publish. If we need immediate rollback we should avoid cache-heavy assets for the first 5m.

emma: Quick Q: what are we saying in deprecation notes for legacy sync client? we need a short line and migration snippet.

maria: Good call. Draft note: "Legacy sync client (v1) will be deprecated on 2025-07-01; please migrate to async clients or the new unified API. See migration guide: /docs/migrate-sync-to-async" I'll post the full changelog after final.

oliver: Canary smoke shows one failing test in TS packaging: `auth-header-format` (flaky). Reproduced locally once. Not sure if it's packaging or a transient auth stub.

maria: OK don't cut final yet. If it's flaky we should regen signer keys and republish canary to ensure metadata matches. Plan: regen signers -> republish canary -> run smoke -> decide.

lisa: I'm starting a hotfix build to isolate packaging differences. Commands I'll run: ```bash
# TS canary republish
npm version prerelease --preid=canary && npm publish --tag canary
# Py canary republish
python -m build && twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*
```

emma: Also remember to update the CHANGELOG entry with the deprecation and streaming API note. I'll prep the snippet while we wait.

deploy-bot: Key rotation request received. Action: `regen_signer_keys` queued.

raj: I'll run the regen now, it'll take ~10m to rotate keys and update metadata. Notifying package registries after keys are in place.

deploy-bot: Signer keys rotated for py wheel metadata: key id `abc123` at 2025-06-10T16:18:22Z. Metadata checksum changed.

oliver: Re-ran smoke against the regen canary — all tests passed locally (100% for smoke suite). The previous `auth-header-format` failure did not reproduce. QA gives thumbs-up.

maria: OK final publish window moved to 16:30 UTC to allow a final quick validation. Pin outcome if green: `py@2.1.0`, `ts@2.1.0`. Rollback pins if we need to revert: `py@2.0.9`, `ts@2.0.9`. Deprecation note: legacy-sync v1 deprecated 2025-07-01. Also add migration snippet for streaming signature change.

emma: :thumbsup: I'll push the CHANGELOG + migration snippet to the release PR now.

lisa: Publishing final now (cutting releases to main registries).

deploy-bot: Final publish succeeded: `redwood-sdk-py@2.1.0` (build 20250610-pt1-final), `redwood-sdk-ts@2.1.0` (build 20250610-tt1-final). Release artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/releases/20250610/

maria: Closing the release window. If any post-release regressions are reported in the next 30m open #incidents and we will rollback to the saved pins: `py@2.0.9`, `ts@2.0.9`. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — I'll follow up with the release notes and checklist in the release PR.

emma: I'll also add a short post on #general about the deprecation timeline and link to migration docs.

raj: Staying on monitor for 30m and will escalate if anything crosses the guardrail thresholds.
